title: The Cartier–Miller evaluation of coefficient sums
description: Truncated powers of a polynomial of degree three or four over a prime field and the curve v^2 = f(w): the coefficient that gives the trace of the curve, the truncated sum as a sum over the points of the curve and as a character sum, and the statement of D. Jordan's theorem (2026) that evaluates these sums with about log p operations through the arithmetic of the curve.

units.title: Truncated powers and points of a curve

prerequisites: core course Abstract Algebra II (C40): finite fields, polynomials, the number of roots of a polynomial
the first lesson proves every other fact it uses
